result:
Summary: The sources provide various metrics for BM25 retrieval in the context of HotpotQA. On the HOTPOTQA benchmark, BM25 achieved a Mean Average Precision (MAP) of 0.324, Hits@10 of 0.191, and Hits@20 of 0.259. In another study, BM25's performance decreased from 53.7% to 25.9% for finding all supporting evidence for a question on the 'easy' and 'hard' subsets of the HOTPOTQA training dataset. In a different context, BM25 achieved Recall@10 of 0.834, MRR@10 of 0.6492, and NDCG@10 of 0.6863. The sources do not provide a definitive answer for the exact Hits@10 BM25 retrieval metric value for HotpotQA original test.
